rules.name: Xcode DerivedData
rules.explanation: Xcode build products. Safe to clear. Rebuilds itself.

rules.name: Xcode archive
rules.explanation: Builds you archived for release. Keep the ones you may need to read crash reports.

rules.name: Simulators
rules.explanation: iOS simulators and their data.
rules.instruction: Remove old ones in Xcode › Settings › Components.

rules.name: Simulator runtimes
rules.explanation: Simulator runtimes Xcode downloaded.
rules.instruction: Remove them in Xcode › Settings › Components.

rules.name: node_modules
rules.explanation: Packages for a JavaScript project. Safe to clear. Reinstall them with npm install.

rules.name: npm cache
rules.explanation: npm's download cache. Safe to clear. npm fetches what it needs again.

rules.name: Yarn cache
rules.explanation: Yarn's download cache. Safe to clear. Yarn fetches what it needs again.

rules.name: pnpm store
rules.explanation: pnpm's package store. Safe to clear. pnpm fetches what it needs again.

rules.name: pip cache
rules.explanation: pip's download cache. Safe to clear. pip fetches what it needs again.

rules.name: Homebrew cache
rules.explanation: Downloads Homebrew kept after installing. Safe to clear. brew cleanup does the same.

rules.name: Cargo registry
rules.explanation: Rust crates Cargo downloaded. Safe to clear. Cargo fetches what it needs again.

rules.name: Gradle caches
rules.explanation: Gradle's build and download cache. Safe to clear. Gradle rebuilds it.

rules.name: App cache
rules.explanation: App caches. Safe to clear. Apps rebuild what they need.

rules.name: Old installer
rules.explanation: An installer you downloaded over a month ago. Once the app is installed, you don't need it.

rules.name: Final Cut render files
rules.explanation: Final Cut Pro renders. Safe to clear. Final Cut renders them again.

rules.name: Final Cut proxies
rules.explanation: Proxy and optimized media. Final Cut can make them again from the originals, but it takes a while.

rules.name: Premiere media cache
rules.explanation: Premiere Pro's media cache. Safe to clear. Premiere rebuilds it.

rules.name: DaVinci Resolve cache
rules.explanation: DaVinci Resolve's render cache. Safe to clear. Resolve renders it again.

rules.name: Docker
rules.explanation: The virtual disk Docker runs on. It grows but never shrinks by itself.
rules.instruction: Reclaim space in Docker › Settings › Resources.

rules.name: iPhone and iPad backups
rules.explanation: iPhone and iPad backups.
rules.instruction: Manage them in Finder › your device › Manage Backups.

rules.name: Photos library
rules.explanation: Your Photos library.
rules.instruction: Shrink it from inside Photos, not here.

rules.name: Trash
rules.explanation: Files in the Trash.
rules.instruction: Empty the Trash in Finder to get this space back.

rules.name: Trash
rules.explanation: Files in this drive's Trash.
rules.instruction: Empty the Trash in Finder to get this space back.
